explanation: Visium tests follow the HYPOMAP conventions. Region names, the absence of a minimum-spot or sparse rule, and pooling every spot to summarise a region follow the HYPOMAP authors (Tadross et al. 2025, Supplementary Table 20 and Methods). externalReference.test.ts checks 143 samples, the authors' region names (LH/RCN as lateral hypothalamus / retrochiasmatic nucleus, Ventricular hypothalamus), no compartment or sparse fields, pool weights equal to each sample's library size, and ARC's pooled POMC (134,074 counts over 110,969,984). regionalSummary.test.ts ranks by the pooled value, keeps a donor in two regions and flags Unassigned. portalCards.test.tsx expects ARC, VMH, LTN, Vascular and ME with Unassigned left unranked.
